description: Oral diadochokinesis: count the syllables of a pa / ta / ka / pataka repetition and return the syllable rate (first 9 syllables and overall), regularity (COV, nPVI) and acceleration. With gender and an age of 65 to 86, the rate is compared with Pierce et al. 2013 norms for healthy adults; outside that age range there is no published norm. Regularity and acceleration have no validated cut-off: do not present them as normal or abnormal. BEFORE CALLING: Confirm the recording is a repetition of the chosen task, at least 5 s, as fast as possible (or, for pa_steady, /pa/ repeated 30+ times at a regular comfortable pace).

speakerAge.description: Speaker age in years, needed for the norm comparison (norms cover 65 to 86)

speakerGender.description: Speaker gender, needed for the norm comparison

task.description: Task performed: pa, ta, ka, pataka (as fast as possible) or pa_steady

name: vocametrix_measure_ddk
